name: frozen_native50_rgb_baseline8_seed20261024_v1
purpose: Single project eight-class baseline using frozen input; not author-exact reproduction or a multi-arm campaign

data.validation_order: sorted video_id; every allowed video exactly once
data.test: no loader or CLI test path
data.frozen_content_flags: preserve; no exclusion/relabeling from visual review

model.pooling: mean over T,H,W after ResNet50 features; then Linear(2048,8)

initialization.seed_reason: First seed in existing research sequence; fixed before any eight-class score, no seed search
initialization.source_head: 1000-class ImageNet head is checked then discarded
initialization.task_head: fresh torch.nn.Linear(2048,8) constructor initialization; seed once immediately before constructing VideoResNet50; preserve new head during transfer
initialization.backbone_transfer: existing load_imagenet_state strict complete key/shape/dtype/finite checks; all non-fc backbone weights and BN statistics
initialization.forbidden_helper: weights.initialized_baseline(seed) hardcodes num_classes=2; implement isolated eight-class initializer without editing frozen helper

trainability.train: all backbone convolution and eight-class fc parameters
trainability.freeze: all BatchNorm affine parameters and running buffers; eval mode reapplied after model.train()

gradient_clip.when: once after full effective-batch accumulation before optimizer.step

batch.gradient_rule: For effective batch of actual size B, backprop each microbatch summed unweighted 8-class CE divided by B; zero_grad once before window; step once after window
batch.not_equivalent_claim: No assertion of bitwise equivalence to physical batch16; BN frozen is a project choice

loss_metrics.training_loss: 8-class CE; no class weights, smoothing, or auxiliary binary loss
loss_metrics.training_device_plan: CUDA FP32 logits/targets, explicit functional.cross_entropy(sum)/actual_B; CPU-only adapter CE is not called on CUDA tensors
loss_metrics.metrics_device_plan: detach logits to CPU float32, targets to CPU int64; use EightClassMetrics float64 CE accumulation
loss_metrics.validation: eval/no_grad; all 1547 videos; compute eight-class CE and metrics; no train-time BN updates
loss_metrics.binary: diagnostic only; map eight-class argmax; do not sum class probabilities or select by binary accuracy

stopping.improvement: strict less-than best complete validation CE
stopping.incomplete_validation: do not append history or update best/bad_epochs; repeat entire validation on explicit resume
stopping.nan_or_infinity: fail and preserve last valid checkpoint; no silent skip
stopping.early_stop: stop when bad_epochs >= 5; no automatic extension

runtime_plan.device: one CUDA GPU; no silent CPU fallback
runtime_plan.loader_generator_seed: seed + epoch_index + 100000; separate from model RNG

checkpoint_plan.cadence: every 25 optimizer updates, train-epoch end, validation commit, and requested stop at optimizer boundary
checkpoint_plan.writes: atomic checkpoint then authoritative progress; histories recover from committed checkpoint if interrupted
checkpoint_plan.resume: explicit user request only; same run schema, plan/data/code/runtime identities; no old binary or other split checkpoint
checkpoint_plan.progress_formula: completed_epochs*450 + ceil(cursor/16); cursor multiple of16 or7192
checkpoint_plan.validation_commit: transaction must bind selected best checkpoint to selected epoch; recovery must not pair a new history with an old best.pt

integration_requirements: New isolated eight-class initializer, not old two-class helper; record exact transferred tensors and fresh head.
Frozen loader/old trainer unchanged; bridge batch.records to video-order checks, not old batch.video_id assumptions.
Implement CPU/GPU loss bridge with explicit eight-class targets; do not silently broaden the current CPU metrics contract.
New metrics checkpoint serialization and validation needed; old binary Metrics.state is incompatible.
Verify model parameter counts/BN buffers and no source tensor transformations beyond frozen contract.
Trainer launch, model readiness, resource checks, full validation and resume recovery remain unimplemented/unverified; no automatic launch.

paper_and_project_boundary.paper_supported_direction: ResNet50 baseline, eight classes, T50 RGB 120x160, ImageNet initialization; Adam/lr1e-4/batch16/30 epoch starting cap and validation-loss early stopping
project_choices: patience5, clip1, Adam flags, no scheduler
explicit macro-F1 and binary mapping, checkpoint rules
